blurb: Guests participate in electric karting races on private tracks, Laser Tag missions in futuristic arenas, Gelly Ball battles, Escape Games, and arcade games. Group packages are customizable and suitable for various occasions including birthdays, bachelor parties, youth groups, and corporate events. Activities include warm-up, qualifying, and final races for karting, and multiple missions for Laser Tag and Gelly Ball.
